result.title: VGGA: Geometry-Grounded Autoencoder for Video Generation
result.summary: Autoencoders are the core component of latent video generative models, compressing high-dimensional videos into compact latent spaces for downstream generation. However, existing video autoencoders are primarily optimized for pixel-level reconstruction, providing limited supervision for learning structured latent representations. We argue that videos should not be treated merely as signals to be reconstructed, but rather as 2D projections of dynamic 3D worlds that exhibit explicit and well-structured geometric properties. Building on this insight, we propose \textbf{V}ideo \textbf{G}eometry \textbf{G}rounded \textbf{A}utoencoder (\textbf{VGGA}), a geometry-aware video autoencoder that explicitly incorporates geometric constraints into the reconstruction process. Specifically, VGGA grounds the learned representations along three complementary geometric dimensions: \emph{Structural Depth}, \emph{Motion Correspondence}, and \emph{Projective Warping}. These objectives are unified within a Video Geometry Decoder, which employs a shared spatio-temporal upsampling trunk to jointly optimize geometric learning and RGB reconstruction. Through these geometry-grounded objectives, VGGA encourages the latent representations to capture the underlying 3D structure and motion of dynamic scenes. VGGA consistently improves video generation across both geometry-centric and human-motion domains, reducing gFVD by 28.1\% on RealEstate10K and 37.7\% on Taichi-HD. Notably, these substantial generation improvements are achieved while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality, demonstrating that geometry-grounded representation learning yields a more effective latent space for video generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VGGA，一种几何感知的视频自编码器：在重建过程中沿结构深度、运动对应与投影变换三个维度加入几何约束，由共享时空上采样解码器联合优化几何学习与 RGB 重建，使视频 latent 空间捕获场景的 3D 结构与运动，并在多个视频生成基准上降低 gFVD。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文用几何约束直接塑造 latent 表示结构，可能为 LVR 中「内部状态是否保留几何与任务必要信息」提供表示层的方法线索，可供核查这类辅助监督目标能否迁移到推理期 latent 的构造。
